author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Approach: state machine + file_plain mode end-to-end is the AC-15 binding path; per-mode rotation for passphrase_sealed/os_keychain/cloud_kms deferred to phased follow-up (same algorithm, different persist primitive). Migrations: rotation_state, signing_key_history (point-in-time lookup), revoked_keys (append-only). Atomic swap via tokio::sync::watch wrapping Arc<dyn SigningKey>. AC-15 test: emit-rotate-emit-verify-both under issuance-time keys. Failure-injection test: crash between WriteNewKeyMaterial and PublishServiceRecord, resume cleanly without re-generating the key. Audit log: emit tracing::info! structured event (defer DB persistence to #35 when that lands).
